verdict.rationale: Beamer documents its own widget customization: you can tailor the widget to your app's design and personalize the color scheme and fonts. That widget also collects user comments and reactions, a form of feedback intake. However, the customization evidence comes from the changelog widget page, and nothing covers customizing a widget label or confirms the same options apply to the dedicated feedback/idea-collection widget. Missing for 10: evidence of custom label/button text, explicit confirmation that branding options apply to the feedback widget, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can customize the feedback widget's label and colors to match my brand

citations.quote: Tailor our widget to perfectly fit your app’s design.
Personalize color scheme, fonts, notification trigger and more.
Collect user comments and reactions to see what people really think of your latest product updates.
